name: CREMA-D: Crowd-Sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset
description: CREMA-D is a multimodal dataset of 7,442 clips from 91 ethnically diverse actors (48 male, 43 female) performing 12 sentences with six basic emotions (Happy, Sad, Angry, Fearful, Disgusted, Neutral) across four emotion levels (Low, Medium, High, Unspecified). Annotations were validated through crowd-sourced perceptual evaluations.
